detail.longDescription:
Confession: we have all added a task we'd already done, purely to tick it off.

That isn't cheating. It's accurate record-keeping, and a useful reminder that the day was not, in fact, a write-off. Plenty of what we do never makes it onto a list.

PicnicTasks gives every tick a small moment: "One less thing to carry." No streak to protect, no confetti cannon. Just the nice bit.

https://picnictasks.uk/app

#productivity #todolist
